justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-agent/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/agent/ByteBuddyAgent.java` and `byte-buddy-agent/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/agent/ByteBuddyAgentAgentProviderTest.java`. `AgentProvider` is only a nested interface with a single method `resolve()`, and it has just two small implementations: `ForByteBuddyAgent` and `ForExistingAgent`. The implementations are role-specific (create/locate an agent jar vs return an existing file), so the unit is already narrowly scoped and does not show the excessive size, method count, or mixed responsibilities expected for insufficient modularization.
